answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may transact; spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and misbehavior slashes the stake. A public reputation mirror lets anyone audit an agent's past deals, so a fresh fake with no history cannot borrow trust from a reputable peer, and no ivory-tower review board is needed because the stake plus the auditable record make faking expensive and detectable.
